source_claims.paper_split: three repeated per-class randomized 60/20/20 splits within each scene

source_claims.metadata_pdf_parent_snippet_mapping: not provided in the metadata PDF

blockers: Zenodo API says CC BY 4.0 while the included metadata PDF says no commercial use; rights holder clarification is required.
The metadata PDF says short labeled clips were trimmed from five-minute snippets, but no parent-snippet mapping is provided.
Parent recording/session identities and temporal overlap are not yet established.
No independent location/session grouped split has been verified.
Published audio gains do not establish that both modalities are required for the task.
Audio was not anonymized; privacy treatment needs scoped review before use.
